item.title: Toyama Glass Art Museum & Workshop: Contemporary Glass in a Kengo Kuma Building — Guide
item.description: The Toyama Glass Art Museum is housed within a striking building designed by renowned architect Kengo Kuma, part of the wider Toyama Kirari complex, and showcases contemporary glass art from Japanese and international artists across several gallery floors. Beyond the museum displays, visitors can also try a hands-on glassblowing workshop nearby, working under instructor guidance to shape molten glass into their own small piece to take home, reflecting Toyama’s modern reputation as a centre for contemporary glass art.
